purpose: Monad Metropolis 2026 hackathon — QRIS merchant-spend leg (mobile-app/docs/monad-metropolis-2026-spec.md §6.6). Proves `processMerchantPayment` settling a registered ERC-20 on Monad. The remittance leg uses the REAL Agora AUSD on Monad mainnet (143); this testnet deployment deliberately does not, see `ausd.note`.

ausd.note: MockAUSD — our own open-mint 6-decimal stand-in (src/MockAUSD.sol), NOT Agora's testnet AUSD (0xa9012a055bd4e0eDfF8Ce09f960291C09D5322dC), whose mint is permissioned with no faucet (verified on-chain 2026-09-16). decimals()/symbol()/name() read back via cast after deploy: 6 / AUSD / AUSD. 1,000,000 AUSD minted to the deployer at deploy time; anyone can mint more.
